text:
kevin: heads-up — product is pushing a pricing/tier change tomorrow 06:00 UTC that increases Pro quotas. expecting an immediate traffic bump in EU token-heavy routes. rough forecast: +95 GPU-hours/hr peak for first 72h. need a short playbook for smoothing + fallback.

nidhi: ok noted. my plan: enable a 10-min gradual window on quota increases, turn on token-based smoothing, and add a temporary policy to prefer spot capacity in eu-west1. does 10-min window sound right? also need an estimate for reserved vs spot.

eli: quick sanity check on numbers — 95 GPU-hours/hr ~= 95 GPUs sustained at 100% if metric is GPU-hours/hr. that seems high for the initial burst. based on our session profile (avg 30s per session, ~0.4 GPU per session) i'd ballpark 40-60 extra GPUs sustained at peak. recommend we plan for 80 to be safe (allowing headroom + evictions).

sam: product can stagger the rollout by region (eu-north -> eu-west) over 4h windows to shave peak. if infra wants smoothing + fallback we can keep rollout as-is but do a staged throttle policy if capacity alerts fire.

kevin: good — priority items: (1) quota smoothing config (10m ramp), (2) reserve extra spot pool + small on-demand reserve, (3) fallback to smaller quantized model for burst traffic to reduce per-token GPU time, (4) reduce autoscale cooldown to react faster. proposing: spot reserve = 120 GPUs in eu-west1, on-demand reserve = 20 GPUs. fallback model = redwood/llama-7b-q4 (quantized).

ops-bot: triggered runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/capacity-tier-bump (runbook: tier-bump response). alert: capacity-utilization-eu > 85% will page oncall.

nidhi: rough cost math: spot ~ $0.80/hr * 120 = $96/hr, on-demand ~ $3.00/hr * 20 = $60/hr, total ~ $156/hr at peak. if sustained 72h that is ~$11.2k. monthly sustained would be much higher but we expect a short window. adding fallback to `redwood/llama-7b-q4` should cut token GPU time by ~40% in bursts.

eli: operational checks i'm running now: `fleetctl capacity query --region eu-west1 --window 3h --filter "gpu:A100"` and `kubectl get nodes -l fleet=spot -o wide` to watch churn. i'll also lower the autoscaler cooldown to 30s and set eviction-buffer to 15%.

kevin: sample config snippet for quota smoothing (will apply to quota policy in console):
```
quota_smoothing: {
  enabled: true,
  window: "10m",
  step_pct: 15
}
```

sam: @nidhi can you sign off on the smoothing and reserve numbers? product will hold the rollout 15 mins if you need extra time. :thumbsup:

nidhi: signed-off. starting config change now, creating a temp reservation ticket with finance for the spot bump. will post updated utilization forecast in ~30m.

eli: noted — i'll keep an eye on node churn and set a mid-run threshold to flip traffic to fallback model at util >= 82%.

kevin: perfect. if alerts start spiking we'll throttle non-critical routes first (rerank/embeddings heavy) and keep chat/generative routes on fallback model. thanks team.
